about.title: What is Ugrow?
about.description: Ugrow is an academic project by Guilherme Veiga Pedromilo through ICETI. Through a multi-platform desktop application, users will be able to manage their finances in an organized and simple manner, while also learning more about financial education through digital content and educational materials provided within the application.

creator.title: Who is the Creator?
creator.description: Guilherme Veiga Pedromilo is a Software Engineering student at UniCesumar (in training), Systems Developer and Electroelectronics Technician by SENAI. Currently, he is an IT Intern in BRM (Business Relationship Management) at ZF Automotive (ZF Group). Furthermore, he is a musician and academic violinist at the Symphony Orchestra of the Heitor Villa-Lobos School (Americana-SP).
idea.title: Idea and Project
idea.description: The idea was born from the creator's need to manage his own finances, and from noticing that people talk a lot about financial control but most of them don't actually have a good handle on it. So the goal is to create a desktop app for people to manage their finances and learn a little about how to save money.
institutions.title: Institutions Involved
institutions.description: UniCesumar (Cesumar University) and ICETI (Cesumar Institute of Technology and Innovation) are the institutions involved in this project, contributing with their teachers, content and materials, as well as financial and technical support. They work together as official partners, committed to education, innovation and the scientific community.
